title: expression.evaluate
description: Evaluate a metric expression against one event on one of three surfaces (mode): rails = event ingestion by the billing API (value stored into properties[field_name]); ep = the events-processor (expression result stored as text); preview = the expression test endpoint POST /api/v1/billable_metrics/evaluate_expression. See BE-EX for the language and the per-surface input conversions.

expression.description: Expression text (preview: null or empty is allowed and rejected by the endpoint).

event.x-kit-absent: mode ep with event_json, or mode preview without an event
event.description: rails: the submitted event {code, timestamp?, properties?} as sent to POST /api/v1/events (timestamp as in BE-EV; absent = now). preview: the `event` member sent to the preview endpoint {code?, timestamp?, properties?}. ep: the event object handed to the engine (prefer event_json).

event_json.description: ep only: exact JSON text of the event object the events-processor hands to the engine: {"code":…,"timestamp":<number>,"properties":{…}} plus other members the engine ignores; numbers spelled as the processor re-encodes them.

now.description: Wall clock (whole seconds) for a missing timestamp (rails, preview).

value.description: The result: a canonical decimal for a number (compared numerically), the text for a string.

type.description: rails and preview: the result kind (not observable in mode ep).

text.description: Exact text of the result where it lands: rails = the text stored in properties[field_name]; ep = the text the engine returns (stored by the processor); preview = the `value` string of the response body. Compared as text.
